nonDecreaseRule: A ratchet value may never be lowered. Every change to `ratchet` must append a `ratchetHistory` entry carrying the linked issue that reviewed it; changed-code-coverage.test.mjs fails when history regresses or omits an issue.

evidence.note: Each eligible pull-request run uploads its normalized report as an Actions artifact. Only report version 2 or newer is valid evidence: version 1 copied zero-byte LCOV from Vitest shards instead of merging their blob reports. Aggregate twenty valid artifacts to derive the first ratchet; nothing is written back to the repository during observation.

promotion.note: Promotion to enforcement is a separate ruleset change: flip `mode` to "enforcement", set both ratchet values from the observed evidence minus `roundingMarginPercentagePoints`, set `treatUnmeasuredAsUncovered` to true, then add Changed Coverage Report to the required checks.

ratchetHistory.note: Phase 2 observation opened. No merge gate; thresholds stay null until twenty representative runs satisfy the observation success criteria.
